_meta: Story Immersion H2-3 — substitution bridge lines. ONE world-narrator line per BEAT_CANON_TRAINER swap key. When a scheduled road battle is swapped for a canon villain (enterBattleEvent), this line tells the player WHY the scheduled fight is now this person, so the named villain doesn't read as an unexplained reskin. Rendered once at the encounter intro, BEFORE the beat scene. Voice: world-narrator, one line, names the villain + the swap. NO boss-mechanic telegraph (that stays in BOSS_CONFIGS/the banner). Keys mirror BEAT_CANON_TRAINER exactly. See docs/story-design/story-immersion/dialogue-and-writing-CONCLUSION.md §B.
